resources.string: He walks, runs, climbs, swims, dances, and swings on his own. You do not pick the move. Pinch to resize. Drag him and let go to drop him. Tap to type. Double-tap, or Talk, and speak.

Alerts let him tell you who wrote today and what the notification says. Texts and contacts stay on this phone. He does not send them to research. Research only sends a question you ask, and only after you paste your own key here.
Paste a Gemini key. It stays on this phone.
Research key saved on this phone.
No research key yet. He can still open a web search.
Tap the notification to open him. Stop removes him.
Ask, or say play a song
Yo Brian. I am moving on my own. Ask me anything.
